review.notes: Automated line-level comparison of extracted text from all 16 physical PDF pages against the OCR Markdown, plus a code-fence balance scan (no fences present) and a heading scan (all headings match numbered sections). Page 3 architecture and prompt-figure text and the page 1 arXiv stamp exist only inside embedded figure images or the margin stamp, so they are not body droppage. The page 7 equation-adjacent sentence and the page 9 Fleurs footnote line are present in the OCR in LaTeX/reflowed form. Pages 1, 10 and 12 were rendered (150/130/300 dpi) to visually confirm the three patches; the page 12 authors block and bottom footnote were read at 300 dpi.
